logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of metal complexes may influence the cellular uptake efficiency and cytotoxicity, which is usually studied by the shake flask method. The lipophilic properties of the complexes were analyzed by ICP-MS. The lipophilicity is usually expressed by log Po/w, which is the partition coefficient of the complexes distribution between n-octanol and aqueous phase. Negative log Po/w means the complex is hydrophilic and positive log Po/w means the complex is lipophilic. According to the results, the log Po/w of complexes 1 and 3 had negative value of -0.37 ± 0.02 and - 0.19 ± 0.01, respectively, while the value of complex 2 has a positive value of 0.22 ± 0.02 (Table 1). Solvent and pH can affect the lipophilicity of drugs. The logarithm of the distribution coefficient of the compound at certain pH in an organic phase (such as octanol) and an aqueous phase (such as buffer solution) is Log D. With the use of octanol and PBS (pH 7.4), Log D7.4 of the complexes 1–3 were calculated (Table 1).
